dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards the posterior peduncle, forming a smooth parabolic curve.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are largely smooth and symmetrical; no significant asymmetrical bulges or structural indentations are visible along the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values across the dorsal surface with minimal grayscale variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast dark circular mark is present on the anterior dorsal surface near the blowhole region. Faint, low-contrast linear markings are visible along the mid-dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent longitudinal linear indentation is visible along the central dorsal axis in the posterior region, casting a slight shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark circular lesion or marking on the anterior dorsal region; several faint, light-colored linear marks consistent with healed epidermal disruptions on the mid-back.
other_distinctive_markers: The singular, high-contrast dark circular mark on the nuchal/anterior dorsal region serves as a highly unique individual identifier.
